Introduction

Jinseok is a singer under GH Entertainment. He is the maknae and lead vocalist of the boy group B.I.G and is a member of the co-ed group Triple7. He joined B.I.G in January 2019.

On December 15, 2023 Jinseok took to social media to announce that he has left GH Entertainment following his contract ending. It is unclear whether or not B.I.G will continue to promote.
